Success criteria: The right arm grasps the bottle and shakes it horizontally, and at the end it remains clearly lifted above the table.

## Execution tips

- Approach from above at a uniform-width body section near the label, with fingers on opposite sides of the bottle's long axis and an opening slightly wider than that section. Avoid slippery shoulders and the rounded bottom.
- Before closing, confirm both pads surround the bottle rather than pressing only its upward face and rolling the horizontal bottle. Use moderate gripping force on the lightweight plastic bottle to reduce deformation.
- When choosing a shaking area, account for the movement of both ends of the bottle. Leave clearance from the nearby silver bell and black post, avoiding contact from the bottle ends even if the gripper passes through safely.
- Use moderate horizontal back-and-forth shaking with smooth reversals. If the bottle slides against the pads or droops, reduce amplitude and use table support to adjust the grasp if needed rather than releasing in midair.
